name: gotfreefax
description: Send faxes to the US and Canada from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and other AI agents. No account required to start; prepaid accounts unlock larger documents and the no-confirmation paid send path.

authentication.description: Optional Bearer token. Format: 'Bearer ' + base64(account_number + ':' + pin). 4 of 7 tools work anonymously; the rest require a GotFreeFax prepaid account.

tools.name: send_free_fax
tools.description: Send a free fax to a US/Canada number. Max 3 pages, 2/day per email/IP, email-confirmation required before the fax actually sends.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Send a fax via a prepaid account. Up to 300 pages, no confirmation step.

tools.name: check_fax_status
tools.description: Look up the delivery status of a fax by its job_id (the 10-letter PublicId returned by send_*).

tools.name: list_sent_faxes
tools.description: List paid faxes the authenticated account has sent, paginated, most recent first.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Get the current page balance and dollar balance for the authenticated account.

tools.name: purchase_credits
tools.description: Start a prepaid credit purchase. Returns a PayPal payment URL. Authenticated -> credits added to existing account; unauthenticated -> creates a new prepaid account (or loads existing one with same email) and emails credentials after payment.

tools.name: list_supported_formats
tools.description: Static list of accepted file types (PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, JPEG, TXT).

examples.title: Send a free fax
examples.prompt: Send a free fax to 555-123-4567 with the text 'Hello from Claude'.

examples.title: Buy prepaid credits
examples.prompt: I'd like to buy 100 prepaid fax credits — my email is alice@example.com and my name is Alice.

examples.title: Check fax status
examples.prompt: What's the status of fax job ABCDEFGHIJ?
